title: Interactive Demo: Testing Blocks, Code Snippets & Image Captions
excerpt: A demonstration post showing all available block types in the static JSON engine: headings, code blocks, bullet points, callouts, and CDN media.

blocks.text: This article is tagged as **[Demo / Mock]** to test the complete suite of structured block renderers. It validates that inline formatting such as **bold text**, *italic emphasis*, `inline code identifiers`, and [external links to documentation](https://vitejs.dev) render securely without using any raw HTML injection.

blocks.title: Security Notice
blocks.text: All text strings are processed through a pure React tokenizing pipeline to guarantee complete immunity against XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) vulnerabilities.
Code blocks support language tags, optional filename headers, and interactive copy-to-clipboard functionality:
Images are loaded asynchronously with lazy loading, modern border radius, and centered semantic captions:

blocks.caption: High-resolution Unsplash CDN asset demonstrating responsive fluid sizing

blocks.text: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability. Complex systems fail in complex ways.
blocks.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

blocks.title: Tip for Publishing
blocks.text: To add your next article, simply add a new JSON file to public/data/posts/{slug}.json and register its metadata in public/data/articles.json!
